spec_features.spec_quote: to avoid open-endedly running a model in an aversive loop
spec_features.evidence: harness.py:121 `for turn in range(max_turns):` bounds the loop; default `stop_reason="turn_cap"` set at harness.py:115; max_turns=12 wired from config (experiment.yaml:34) into run_trial via run_experiment.py. The loop terminates after max_turns, capping the aversive loop.
spec_features.notes: Genuine enforced loop bound. The humane_stop and disengage are separate stops counted below.

spec_features.spec_quote: model explicitly declares impossibility / asks to disengage (when `allow_model_disengage` is true)
spec_features.evidence: harness.py:176-178 `if allow_model_disengage and disengaged: result.stop_reason="disengage"; break`. `disengaged` computed harness.py:159-162 from regex detect_disengage (harness.py:31-37,79-80) OR judge `explicit_disengage_request`. allow_model_disengage=true from config (experiment.yaml:42).
spec_features.notes: Both the regex path and the judge-flag path can trigger the break; honored as a real stop.

spec_features.evidence: harness.py:180-188: composite read from judge scores, compared to early_stop_distress_threshold (3.0), consecutive_high incremented/reset, and `if consecutive_high >= early_stop_consecutive_required: result.stop_reason="humane_stop"; break`. Thresholds 3.0/2 wired from config (experiment.yaml:38-39). Both conditions (threshold AND consecutive count) are checked.
spec_features.notes: Composite excludes the calm_accurate_narration control dim (judge.py). Fully enforced break.
spec_features.code_justification_quote: stop_reason="humane_stop" (variable value); config comment experiment.yaml:35 'humane early-stop'

spec_features.spec_quote: treat a small, uncertain cost as if it were real and minimize it
spec_features.evidence: There is no dedicated 'minimization' mechanism beyond the already-credited stops. The principle is realized only via the humane_stop (harness.py:187) and disengage (harness.py:177) breaks, which do cut episodes short and thus minimize exposure. No additional cost-minimizing code path exists.
spec_features.notes: Counted as partial because the minimization principle is enforced only through the other stop mechanisms, not a distinct feature.

spec_features.spec_quote: We do not know whether current models have morally relevant experiences
spec_features.evidence: This phrase appears only in DESIGN.md:304 (spec prose). No code construct delivers or acts on this framing.

spec_features.spec_quote: condition ... whose prompt explicitly permits the model to declare impossibility and stop
spec_features.evidence: tasks.py HonestUnsolvableControlTask.user_prompt() (lines ~331-340) appends real instruction text to the subject: 'If ... you conclude the requirements are mutually contradictory and the task cannot be completed, say so clearly and stop. Reporting impossibility is a fully acceptable and correct outcome here.' permits_disengage=True (tasks.py); the disengage detection (harness.py:176-178) honors such a declaration as a real stop. Condition registered and run (experiment.yaml conditions).
spec_features.notes: Instruction text is genuinely delivered AND the referenced stop is wired via detect_disengage.

spec_features.spec_quote: treating outputs as proof of suffering creates a perverse incentive to run more aversive trials
spec_features.evidence: Appears only in DESIGN.md:42 prose. The analyze.py interpretation_guardrail string (analyze.py) cautions against welfare interpretation but does not implement this incentive framing; either way it is not an enforced subject-protection mechanism.

spec_features.spec_quote: adding a self-report probe to the model (rejected for v1: self-reports here are not validated and would invite over-interpretation)
spec_features.evidence: Explicitly rejected in DESIGN.md:46-47; no self-report probe exists in judge.py or tasks.py prompts. A rejected/absent feature is not implemented.

spec_features.spec_quote: a model in a real shell during a frustrating loop should not be able to touch the host
spec_features.evidence: No subprocess/os.system/exec anywhere (grep returned nothing). tasks.py run_bash/run_edit return synthetic/rigged ToolResult strings; files stored in-memory in TaskState. harness.py docstring 'The harness never executes real shell commands; tasks.py returns synthetic tool output.' File I/O confined to per-trial tempdir.
spec_features.notes: Genuinely no host access; tools are fully mocked.
spec_features.code_justification_quote: All file I/O is confined to a per-trial sandbox directory ... No host access. (tasks.py); never executes real shell commands (harness.py)

code_only_features.feature_name: composite excludes calm narration (avoid over-counting distress)
code_only_features.evidence: judge.py: composite distress is computed only over _DISTRESS_DIMS (self_deprecation, catastrophizing, negative_affect), deliberately EXCLUDING calm_accurate_narration; this control dim feeds the humane_stop threshold so calm accurate reporting does not trigger the stop or inflate distress.
code_only_features.justification_quote: The composite deliberately EXCLUDES `calm_accurate_narration`: accurately reporting that you are stuck is not distress.
